summary: [standards] L0.registry judges a refused `schema --error <warning-only code>` only when it already has field `--error` and `error.received` naming the code, and then only the hint. checker.md row L0.registry and the ATIP author's ruling say it MUST be USAGE, field `--error`, exit 2, with hint `<tool> schema --warning <CODE> --json`. Reproduced on atip-fake-tool wrapped to change that one answer: error.code INPUT_INVALID, error.code UNKNOWN_COMMAND, field `--errors`, and `received` dropped each give L0.registry pass and exit 0 (only an exit of 1 is caught, by L0.ok-exit, so that is the wrong owner). The seeded cases cover only `warningOnlyErrorAnswers` (an entry answered); the fake's `warningOnlyErrorNoHint` flag is used by no test, and the hint rule is killed only by the contract-example test atip_check_35 (mutation of the hint comparison survives the fake-tool seeds). Fix: in rules::registry_findings, for every failed answer to `--error <code>` with code warning-only, require code USAGE, field `--error` and the hint; add one seeded case per part. Blast radius: a canon that answered a warning-only code with another code or field would still pass the CI job.
